zones.title: 01 / CHECK-IN HALL
zones.description: An enclosed public room: staffed desks, bag-drop recesses, queue lanes and a clear entrance sightline. Counters sit against a service wall; baggage continues behind it.

zones.title: 02 / SECURITY ROOM
zones.description: Full-height boundaries. Controlled south entry, two screening lanes, separate preparation and recomposure areas, staff station and a controlled north exit. Gates are beyond the exit, not beside the scanners.

zones.title: CAFÉ / TRAVEL SHOP
zones.description: A furnished destination off the airside route, with its own frontage and doorway. Keep the existing stair and mezzanine inside this area.

zones.title: 03 / AIRSIDE CONCOURSE
zones.description: A short connecting space with clear signs at decisions. Café, toilets and separate gate lounges open off it. Its furnishings stay in edge recesses, outside the walking route.

zones.title: 04 / GATE A07 LOUNGE
zones.description: A bounded waiting room with a wide concourse portal, seating banks facing the boarding desk, large A07 identity, flight display, charging ledges and a boarding-only exit to the existing jetbridge.

zones.title: GATE A08 LOUNGE
zones.description: A separate adjacent waiting room: its own entry, desk, display and seating. A wall separates the A07/A08 seating areas so each gate reads immediately.

zones.title: WC LOBBY
zones.description: A 2 m wide airside side passage connects the concourse to the lavatories. A solid wall keeps it outside the security room.

zones.title: WC / ASSISTANCE
zones.description: Enclosed lavatories and assistance rooms with doors off a short lobby. No lavatory door opens straight into a boarding queue.

zones.title: ARRIVALS / RECLAIM
zones.description: A separate landside reclaim room. Its exit joins the public return passage, without crossing the security or gate queues.

zones.title: PUBLIC ARRIVALS RETURN / TROLLEYS
zones.description: A separate public passage along the forecourt edge. Reclaim passengers leave through their own public exit; trolley bays sit outside the through route.

principles: Physical room boundaries and meaningful thresholds
Distinct ceilings and floor fields; simple colors alone are insufficient
A07 and A08 each have a bounded lounge
Keep parked aircraft and jetbridge connection
